children.label: Overview
children: Common cause of uni- and bilateral proptosis
More common in women; associated with smoking

children.label: Phases
children: Active: red painful eyes, swelling and inflammation
Inactive (fibrotic): white eyes; damage may remain

children.label: Signs and symptoms
children: Soft tissue: lid swelling, hyperaemia, chemosis
Lid retraction and lid lag on downgaze

children.label: Investigations
children: Unilateral proptosis: image to assess other causes

children.label: Treatment
children: Treating thyroid dysfunction alone does not necessarily treat eye disease
